ref: #2 §3: ifWithoutElse passes its then input where the condition is true; its else value is a function parameter, and the empty-string else value is skipped while the SUPPRESS one keeps its slot and the queues in step [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/5d/db0e83e8e74202a5bff527055ab7e5/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bf416d9eaca4c86e10000000a42189e.html]; assumed reading of #78: a context function whose box parameter keepSuppressValues (PO's "Keep SUPPRESS Values", label and default [COMM]) is false by default, so a false condition leaves no slot, and true gives SUPPRESS at the slot; only the exact text true is true (#77); obs-ifwithoutelse (#35) and obs-boolean decide it
note: ifWithoutElse(Qty, Sku), both in context Orders, without params, onto Item; V is Sku in its default context Line. Lines (a, true), (b, false), (c, true), (d, true): the false b leaves no slot, so Item has the slots a, c, d and their numbers 1, 2, 3 read the Line contexts of a, b and c. With keepSuppressValues it would be a, c, d (fn/ifWithoutElse/002).
